data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test describes rather than constrains when the acceptance criterion is 'shown-to-fail-first' because the failure is planted into the record before the test can reject it; the test then only re-describes what installation already committed.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the shown-to-fail-first step were reversible after the test runs","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1/9 mutation were in a non-guard code path that happens to affect compile.py","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the distribution held across multiple authors rather than one author","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The installation ritual requires a shown failure before the guard is installed.
